## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

### Import survey data

```{r import-data}
c_df <- read_csv(
  here("Raw Data", "caregiver_survey.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    postcode_c_1 = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
)

y_df <- read_csv(
  here("Raw Data", "young_person_survey.csv")
)
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
head(c_df)
head(y_df)
```

### Create folders

```{r folders}
dir.create(here("Clean Data"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Initial cleaning

### 1.1 Remove metadata rows

```{r remove-metadata}
c_df <- c_df[-c(1, 2), ]
c_df <- type_convert(
  c_df,
  col_types = cols(
    postcode_c_1 = col_character(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
)
head(c_df)
nrow(c_df)

y_df <- y_df[-c(1, 2), ]
y_df <- type_convert(y_df)
head(y_df)
nrow(y_df)
```

### 1.2 Check for problems

```{r check-problems}
problems(c_df)
problems(y_df)
```

### 1.3 Drop irrelevant columns from each df

```{r drop-columns}
names(c_df)[c(1:7, 9:11)]
names(y_df)[c(1:7, 9:11)]

c_df <- c_df %>%
  select(-c(1:7, 9:11))
y_df <- y_df %>%
  select(-c(1:7, 9:11))

# Quick check
head(c_df)
head(y_df)
```

### 1.4 Clean LinkCode variable

```{r clean-linkcode}
clean_linkcode <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  x
}

c_df <- c_df %>% mutate(LinkCode = clean_linkcode(LinkCode))
y_df <- y_df %>% mutate(LinkCode = clean_linkcode(LinkCode))
```

### 1.5 Remove rows with low completeness

```{r remove-low-completeness}
# Settings
min_items <- 6   # minimum number of answered survey items (IDs excluded)
id_cols <- c("ResponseId", "LinkCode")

# Add completeness variable
count_answered <- function(df, id_cols) {
  df %>%
    select(-all_of(id_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ !(is.na(.x) | str_trim(as.character(.x)) == ""))) %>%
    rowSums()
}

c_df <- c_df %>% mutate(completeness_c = count_answered(., id_cols))
y_df <- y_df %>% mutate(completeness_y = count_answered(., id_cols))

# Distribution before filtering
c_table_before <- table(c_df$completeness_c >= min_items)
y_table_before <- table(y_df$completeness_y >= min_items)

# Rows that will be removed
c_removed_rows <- c_df %>% filter(completeness_c < min_items)
y_removed_rows <- y_df %>% filter(completeness_y < min_items)

c_n_removed <- nrow(c_removed_rows)
y_n_removed <- nrow(y_removed_rows)

# Apply filter
c_df <- c_df %>% filter(completeness_c >= min_items)
y_df <- y_df %>% filter(completeness_y >= min_items)

# Print summary
print(c_table_before)
print(c_n_removed)
print(c_removed_rows)

print(y_table_before)
print(y_n_removed)
print(y_removed_rows)

# Drop completeness columns
c_df <- c_df %>% select(-completeness_c)
y_df <- y_df %>% select(-completeness_y)
```

### 1.6 Check for LinkCode duplicates

```{r linkcode-duplicates}
# Multiple LinkCodes caregiver survey
c_multiple <- c_df %>%
  count(LinkCode) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
c_multiple

# Multiple LinkCodes young person survey
y_multiple <- y_df %>%
  count(LinkCode) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
y_multiple
```

### 1.7 Inspect duplicated LinkCodes

```{r check-duplicated-linkcodes}
# Show all rows for any LinkCode that appears more than once
c_rows_to_print <- c_df %>%
  filter(LinkCode %in% c_multiple$LinkCode) %>%
  arrange(LinkCode)
c_rows_to_print

y_rows_to_print <- y_df %>%
  filter(LinkCode %in% y_multiple$LinkCode) %>%
  arrange(LinkCode)
y_rows_to_print
```

### 1.8 Remove duplicated participants

```{r remove-duplicates}
# Remove duplicate responses: keep the most complete response per LinkCode
remove_least_complete <- function(df, id_cols) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(.completeness = count_answered(., id_cols))

  # Only deduplicate rows with a LinkCode
  keep <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(LinkCode)) %>%
    group_by(LinkCode) %>%
    arrange(desc(.completeness), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  na_rows <- df %>% filter(is.na(LinkCode))

  bind_rows(keep, na_rows) %>% select(-.completeness)
}

# Run the dedupe once per survey
c_dedup <- remove_least_complete(c_df, id_cols)
y_dedup <- remove_least_complete(y_df, id_cols)

# Keep a record of what was removed
c_dupes_removed <- anti_join(c_df, c_dedup, by = "ResponseId")
y_dupes_removed <- anti_join(y_df, y_dedup, by = "ResponseId")

c_dupes_removed
y_dupes_removed

# Apply
c_df <- c_dedup
y_df <- y_dedup

# Check: stops knitting if any LinkCode is still duplicated
stopifnot(
  !any(duplicated(na.omit(c_df$LinkCode))),
  !any(duplicated(na.omit(y_df$LinkCode)))
)
```

## 2. Combine young person and caregiver dfs

### 2.1 Relabel ResponseId

```{r relabel-responseid}
c_df <- c_df %>%
  rename(ResponseId_c = ResponseId)

y_df <- y_df %>%
  rename(ResponseId_y = ResponseId)
```

### 2.2 Combine using LinkCode

```{r combine-caregiver-self-dfs}
# Capture survey-specific column names before joining
c_cols <- setdiff(names(c_df), c("LinkCode", "ResponseId_c"))
y_cols <- setdiff(names(y_df), c("LinkCode", "ResponseId_y"))

cat("=== Intersecting columns ===\n")
intersect(c_cols, y_cols)
stopifnot(length(intersect(c_cols, y_cols)) == 0)

# Count responses with missing LinkCode (these cannot be matched)
cat("=== Missing LinkCode ===\n")
c_n_missing_link <- sum(is.na(c_df$LinkCode))
y_n_missing_link <- sum(is.na(y_df$LinkCode))
c_n_missing_link
y_n_missing_link

# Inspect them before they are dropped
c_missing_link_rows <- c_df %>% filter(is.na(LinkCode))
y_missing_link_rows <- y_df %>% filter(is.na(LinkCode))
c_missing_link_rows
y_missing_link_rows

# Join, keeping only rows with a LinkCode
df_raw_full <- full_join(
  c_df %>% filter(!is.na(LinkCode)),
  y_df %>% filter(!is.na(LinkCode)),
  by = "LinkCode"
)

head(df_raw_full)
```

### 2.3 Coalesce ResponseId

```{r coalesce-responseid}
# Coalesce ResponseId (caregiver ID first, then young person ID)
df_raw_full <- df_raw_full %>%
  mutate(ResponseId = coalesce(ResponseId_c, ResponseId_y))

# Checks
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_raw_full), "\n")
cat("Unique ResponseIds:", n_distinct(df_raw_full$ResponseId), "\n")
cat("Missing ResponseIds:", sum(is.na(df_raw_full$ResponseId)), "\n")

stopifnot(
  sum(is.na(df_raw_full$ResponseId)) == 0,
  n_distinct(df_raw_full$ResponseId) == nrow(df_raw_full)
)
```

### 2.4 Flag orphan reports

```{r flag-orphans}
# Flag missing reports (derived from ResponseIds, not item columns)
df_raw_full <- df_raw_full %>%
  mutate(
    caregiver_missing = is.na(ResponseId_c),   # young person-only row
    self_missing      = is.na(ResponseId_y)    # caregiver-only row
  )

# Inspect flags
table(df_raw_full$caregiver_missing, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_raw_full$self_missing, useNA = "ifany")

# Check: a row can't be missing both reports
stopifnot(!any(df_raw_full$caregiver_missing & df_raw_full$self_missing))

# Check: flags agree with the item columns
# (a report present by ID but with all items NA would show up here)
df_raw_full %>%
  filter(
    (!caregiver_missing & if_all(all_of(c_cols), is.na)) |
    (!self_missing      & if_all(all_of(y_cols), is.na))
  ) %>%
  select(LinkCode, ResponseId_c, ResponseId_y)

# Check: view the unmatched rows
df_raw_full %>%
  filter(caregiver_missing | self_missing) %>%
  select(LinkCode, ResponseId_c, ResponseId_y, caregiver_missing, self_missing) %>%
  head(10)
```

### 2.5 Sample size

```{r combined-sample}
# Sample size
sample_summary <- tibble(
  measure = c(
    "Rows in combined df",
    "Unique LinkCodes",
    "Unique caregiver responses",
    "Unique young person responses",
    "Matched pairs (both reports present)",
    "Caregiver-only (self orphan)",
    "Young person-only (caregiver orphan)"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(df_raw_full),
    n_distinct(df_raw_full$LinkCode),
    n_distinct(df_raw_full$ResponseId_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distinct(df_raw_full$ResponseId_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!is.na(df_raw_full$ResponseId_c) & !is.na(df_raw_full$ResponseId_y)),
    sum(df_raw_full$self_missing),
    sum(df_raw_full$caregiver_missing)
  )
)

sample_summary

# Sanity checks: stop knitting if the counts don't add up
stopifnot(
  nrow(df_raw_full) == n_distinct(df_raw_full$LinkCode),
  sample_summary$n[5] + sample_summary$n[6] + sample_summary$n[7] == nrow(df_raw_full)
)
```

### 2.6 Check df

```{r view-df}
head(df_raw_full)
str(df_raw_full)
```

## 3. Save full raw df

```{r save-df}
saveRDS(df_raw_full, here("Clean Data", "df_raw_full.rds"))
```
